scope: Explicit bounded two-turn one-coil CAD examples; no field calculation

solids.note: Engineering closed radial winding reconstruction, not measured or OEM construction. Exact saved turns and conductor metal area are represented; enamel clearances and residual insulation remain inside the original pack. Auxiliary winding-only CAD adds no independent opaque cartridge or beam boundary. Core/pole material response and lead routing are excluded from the ideal vacuum source. The angular datum is shared by CAD and source.
